newsitem.title: USA: Best files Q2 loss with SEC.
newsitem.headline: Best files Q2 loss with SEC.

text.p: Best Products Co Inc Tuesday said that its net loss for the second quarter ended August 3 was $31.5 million, or $1.01 per share, compared with a year-earlier net loss of $7.1 million, or $0.23 per share, in the second quarter of 1995.
Sales were $268.0 million compared with $311.8 million, the company said in its notification of late filing - Form 12B-25 - with the Securities and Exchange Commission in Washington.
For the six-month period, the company's loss was $66.1 million, or $2.11 per share, compared to a loss of $15.2 million, or $0.48 per share, in the year-earlier period.
Sales for the first half were $537.8 million compared with $584.6 million a year ago.
In the filing, Best said it needed additional time to prepare its form 10-Q for its second quarter.
Asked to confirm the figures, Best Products said they were accurate.
